messages:
Tess: Found a confusing inconsistency in the generate API docs: the OpenAPI example shows "temperature" as a string in some examples (e.g. "0.7") and as a number in others (0.7). This is making the generated SDKs use the wrong type in a few languages.

Victor: Oof. Which page/PR?

Tess: docs/reference/generate.md and the OpenAPI spec at specs/openapi/generate.yaml. PR #5342 introduced a copy-paste example that used "temperature": "0.5". The correct shape is a numeric value. Example currently in the docs:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-mini",
  "input": "Write a haiku",
  "temperature": "0.5"
}
```
Should be:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-mini",
  "input": "Write a haiku",
  "temperature": 0.5
}
```

Nora: That explains user bug reports saying their Python client crashes when calling client.generate(temperature="0.5") because type hints expect float. The snippet generator pulled the string example so some languages got a string param.

Sam: docs-bot posted the CI failure earlier: examples-lint flagged example_param_type mismatch on generate.yaml.

docs-bot: PR #5342  examples-lint  failed: example_param_type mismatch in specs/openapi/generate.yaml. CI logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/5342/logs

Victor: Plan: Tess will fix the docs examples (both the MD page and the OpenAPI primary example) and Sam will regen the SDK snippets. Nora, can you add a quick test to examples-lint to assert numeric params are unquoted in examples for known numeric fields (temperature, top_k, top_p, max_new_tokens)?

Tess: I'll open a tiny PR to replace stringy numbers with numeric literals in both docs/reference/generate.md and specs/openapi/generate.yaml. I'll also add a short migration note: "Note: temperature and other sampling params must be numeric values; examples that show them as strings may cause SDKs to infer the wrong type."

Sam: After Tess' PR lands, I'll run the snippet generator and push updated language snippets. I'll also check the generated Python/TS clients to ensure signatures are typed as float/number.

Nora: Adding the linter rule now. Should be a small addition: parse example JSON blocks and validate that fields listed in a numeric-param whitelist are JSON numbers, not strings. I'll put the test in the examples-lint suite so it fails fast.

Tess: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5360  includes both the MD fix and the OpenAPI example change.

docs-bot: PR #5360 opened by Tess  examples-lint pending.

Sam: Local snippet regen shows Python client signature now is generate(self, *, model: str, input: str, temperature: float | None = None, ...). Previously temperature was annotated as str in a few languages. Looks good.

Nora: Linter change submitted in PR #5364  tiny test, should prevent regressions.

docs-bot: PR #5360 merged by Tess  CI green. PR #5364 merged  tests green.

Victor: Nice catch. I'll update the changelog entry: "docs(generate): ensure numeric sampling params illustrated as numbers; fix examples and regen SDK snippets" and close the ticket.

Tess: Marking the docs issue resolved and adding a short follow-up to audit other API pages for similar string-number mixups. :white_check_mark:
